notes.title: Torchlight: Infinite - Major Update: Clockwork Ballet
notes.notes:
Hunters, prepare to dive into the intricate dance of gears and magic in the latest season of Torchlight: Infinite.
The Clockwork Ballet update brings a symphony of new content, balance adjustments, and gameplay enhancements that mark Torchlight: Infinite's one year anniversary, and look to bring your experience to new heights!

Launch Date: July 4th at 7 PM PST

New Gameplay and Content:

 Season-Exclusive Gameplay: Clockwork Ballet: Engage in the unique and challenging seasonal content.
 Seasonal Talent: Discover new talents exclusive to this season.
 Seasonal Boss: Silverwing Danseuse: Face off against the elegant yet deadly new boss.
 New Hero Trait: Zealot of War: Unleash the power of war with this new hero trait.
 New Legendary Gear: Equip yourself with powerful new legendary items.
 New Legendary Pactspirit: Summon and harness the abilities of new Pactspirits.
 New Netherrealm Talent System: Customize your Netherrealm adventures with the revamped talent system that completely replaces Trait Cards.
 Crafting Overhaul: Legendary crafting and changes to all other crafting systems
 Netherream Overhaul: Removal of Deep Space, better mid and endgame experience.
 Additional Content: Explore various new additions and enhancements.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42897432/674f077dbc1249553c372f5acb5ea5360ccb44ff.jpg

 Brand New PC UI: Experience the game with an optimized and user-friendly interface designed for PC.
 Mechanism Adjustments: Detailed updates to various game mechanisms for a smoother experience.
 Balance Adjustments: Changes to skills and game balance to enhance the player experience.
 Gameplay Adjustments: Tweaks and updates to improve overall gameplay.
 Other Optimization Tweaks: General optimizations to boost game performance and user experience.



For a clear overview of what's coming, here Is our official Season Preview!

[previewyoutube=t6Fsh7kXnl4;full][/previewyoutube]


📜 Detailed Patch Notes: https://torchlight.xd.com/en/news/single?id=tjiwsuhfoGpD

These patch notes cover most of the new content and adjustments, but please check the detailed values in-game after the season launch. Note that some changes are still in progress, and minor adjustments might be made before the season launch.

notes.title: 【Whispering Mist】Season Preview Livestream Replay & Season Patch Notes
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h_B71cOYcxU

Torchlight hunters, the wait is over! The new season, "Whispering Mist," will officially be available on April 18th at 7pm PDT.

👁️ Whispering Mist 👁️

In the new season, hunters can obtain Infection Progress by defeating Mistville Residents and proceed to Mistville through the Mistville Trader to become a mist detective, experiencing a series of bizarre and mysterious folklore events. After completing the folklore challenges, hunters will have a chance to obtain the mysterious item of this season - "Activation Medium"!

👁️ New Support Skill: Activation Medium 👁️

Activation Medium is a new type of support skill added in the Whispering Mist season. It can help hunters automatically trigger active skills and even bring additional special effects to active skills. In the new season, different Activation Mediums have different effects and trigger conditions, allowing every hunter the opportunity to free their hands!

👁️ New Trait: Lightning Shadow 👁️

The cat generator is here! With the help of Ember technology, Lightning Shadow Erika runs with sparks and lightning, gaining faster movement speed and higher damage! She can record the highest shock damage dealt within a certain period into her homemade "Feline Figure," which has a chance to appear when Erika hits an enemy, shocking all enemies within range!

👁️ Important Optimization 👁️

Multiple optimization items are now live, addressing pain points: Build codes and filter codes are now cross-server compatible, Help manual iteration, early game process acceleration, one-click pick up for stackable items of the same type, free trial of all hero traits when purchasing a manual... Crow is working hard to bring hunters a better experience!

For more details, please check:  Whispering Mist Season Patch Notes

notes.title: Season Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Torchlight Hunters,
The Ember's Rest Hideout will undergo maintenance from May 9th 10:00 to May 10th 08:00 (UTC+8). This maintenance is a mandatory update, and players will need to download and install a new client in order to enter the game.
- Android: Go to TapTap or Google Play and download the latest client.
- iOS: Go to the App Store and download the latest client.
- PC: Go to our official website or Steam to download the latest client.
After this mandatory update, the new season "Cube of Rapacity" will begin. For detailed season update logs, please proceed to our community to view them.
 Season Patch Note 
We truly appreciate your support!
